root.label: constexpr in C++26
root.note: New operations the constant evaluator can check; nothing may still escape the evaluation.

children.label: Type erasure
children.note: Operations that make any-like and function_ref-like code usable at compile time.

children.label: void* cast (P2738)
children.note: Allowed back to a type similar to the pointed-to object; any other target type is not constant.

children.label: Placement new (P2747)
children.note: Allowed into storage created in the same evaluation, for an object that transparently replaces the old one.

children.label: Still banned
children.note: reinterpret_cast, reading inactive union members, and bit_cast involving pointers.

children.label: Exceptions (P3068)
children.note: throw, try and catch work during constant evaluation.

children.label: Must be caught
children.note: An exception that escapes the evaluation makes the expression non-constant.

children.label: Library exception types
children.note: std::exception, bad_alloc and, via P3378, logic_error, out_of_range and the bad_*_access types are constexpr.

children.label: exception_ptr
children.note: make_exception_ptr and rethrow_exception are constexpr, but an exception_ptr cannot persist in a constexpr variable.

children.label: Rolled back (P3842)
children.note: current_exception and uncaught_exceptions are not constexpr in N5050.

children.label: Bindings and references
children.note: P2686 lets constexpr reach structured bindings and local objects.

children.label: constexpr auto [a, b]
children.note: constexpr and constinit apply to the hidden variable e; mutable members are still unreadable.

children.label: References to locals
children.note: constexpr int& r = x; is OK when x is an automatic variable of the same function invocation.

children.label: Escape is rejected
children.note: A static constexpr reference or a use inside a nested lambda cannot refer to the local.

children.label: GCC 16 gap
children.note: Accepts constexpr aggregate bindings but rejects constexpr references and pointers to automatics.

children.label: Smaller language changes
children.note: Three constexpr additions that each remove a long-standing workaround.

children.label: Virtual bases (P3533)
children.note: Constexpr constructors and destructors may have virtual bases; only coroutines are not constexpr-suitable.

children.label: static_assert messages (P2741)
children.note: Any constant with size() and data(); evaluated only when the assertion fails.

children.label: is_within_lifetime (P2641)
children.note: consteval test of whether p points to a live object; finds the active union member. Not in GCC 16.

children.label: Library
children.note: Large parts of the library became constexpr in C++26.

children.label: Containers (P3372)
children.note: list, deque, map, set, unordered containers and the adaptors; GCC 16 does not implement these yet.

children.label: Stable algorithms (P2562)
children.note: stable_sort, stable_partition and inplace_merge are constexpr; GCC 16 supports stable_sort.

children.label: cmath (P1383)
children.note: Constant unless the call raises a floating-point exception other than FE_INEXACT, so sqrt(-1.0) is not.

children.label: atomic and format
children.note: P3309 makes atomic constexpr and P3391 does the same for format and integral to_string; neither is in GCC 16.

children.label: Still impossible
children.note: The exit check and the disqualifying operations remain.

children.label: Escaping allocations
children.note: constexpr std::vector with elements is ill-formed; short strings pass only through SSO.

children.label: Disqualified operations
children.note: goto, asm, va_arg, co_await, co_yield, and calls to non-constexpr functions.

children.label: Erroneous behaviour
children.note: Reading an uninitialized local is erroneous in C++26 and, like UB, makes the expression non-constant.
